title: declared-effects.jsonl schema:3 record — common envelope
description: The fields every schema:3 facade record carries, before its verb-specific body. Shape is normative here; semantics live in ../records.md. Exactly one authenticator is present, keyed by `author`: `commissaire_sig` (Ed25519, iff author==commissaire) or `producer_hmac` (iff author==producer) — a constraint this Draft-2020-12 subset validator cannot express, stated in prose and enforced by `audit verify`. `effect` and `payload` are verb-specific and mutually optional here. Enums mirror KIND_AUTHOR in bin/lib/commissaire.js — never redefined.

schema.description: schema:3 is canonical for governed records after the ADR-0122 cutover

seq.description: 0-based position in this run's hash chain; seq 0 is the admission

author.description: who wrote the record; selects the authenticator field

kind_of_entry.description: the stored record KIND (not the CLI action name); mirrors KIND_AUTHOR

issue.description: tracker id, or "-" on the admission

prev.description: SHA-256 hash link over the prior record (chain integrity)

payload.description: verb-specific: present on admission / decision / conclude records

commissaire_sig.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature; present iff author==commissaire

producer_hmac.description: Hex HMAC under K_producer; present iff author==producer
